name: candidate_is_mover_unit
says: Every candidate move starts from a unit of the side to move: the colour of a candidate is the side to move and a unit of that colour stands on its first square. Stated over the description's relations: a row of `candidate` is a row of `mover_unit_move` (the side to move, a unit of that side on the first square, any second square). A fact about play that the layers above rely on when they take the moves of a side as moves of its units; its proof in the library is Ideas.LegalEquiv.candidate_unit.
delta: (signature mover_unit_move side file rank file rank)

proof: obtain ⟨hc, k, hb⟩ := Ideas.LegalEquiv.candidate_unit p a1 a2 a3 a4 a5 h
exact moverUnitMove.c1 hc.symm hb (Ideas.NextEquiv.square_all a4 a5)
